rationale: The short thesis required downside continuation through the 20.86 low, but that trigger never fired; instead price bounced off the low and the last five 1m candles are rising (20.94→21.02) with a high-volume green bar, pushing price above the 9-EMA ($20.98) and back toward VWAP ($21.06). With the short offside and only ~$0.06 from the 21.08 invalidation (under 1 ATR), the setup has stalled and risk/reward no longer favors holding.
